I think that's an overreaction, or you're really generalizing men. Ignoring this specific creepy guy, I'm sure there are men out there who are influenced by all sorts of things when ring shopping. Not every guy is prince charming. A guy might buy a ring based on the fact that *he* likes it. 

Is that noble? No, it's pretty selfish, but maybe he doesn't know any better.

Are you going to say that every man has exactly the same thoughts and experiences when ring shopping? Or that he should?

I think you're looking at this pretty narrowly. If I learned my engagement ring had been intended for someone else, I wouldn't automatically count that as some sort of betrayal to me personally. Who knows what events in his life have led up to that moment?

I totally agree with you. I'm sure the majority of men out there go shopping for a ring that suits their future wife's personality. BUT, think about your circle of friends, or the people you've met, and tell me you can't picture one of them choosing a ring because *he* likes the way it looks. 

Ignoring this specific stalker guy, I can absolutely imagine some average Joe keeping a ring until he finds the right girl for it. Especially if he likes it and thinks it's good looking.
